annotations.title: Search Facilities

description: Search DC Hub's global data-center facility map (170+ countries; corroborated count pending) by text query, country, state, city, operator, or capacity range (min_capacity_mw, max_capacity_mw); limit and offset page through results. Returns each facility's name, provider, location and capacity. Use it for inventory lookups (which facilities match these filters); for a question that also needs power, fiber or risk context, use execute_plan. Keyless calls return a preview.

city.description: City name to filter facilities, e.g. Ashburn, Dallas

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, SG

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

max_capacity_mw.description: Maximum power capacity filter in megawatts (MW)

min_capacity_mw.description: Minimum power capacity filter in megawatts (MW)

mpp_credential.description: Stripe MPP step 2: the Shared Payment Token minted for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call.

mpp_pay.description: Stripe MPP step 1: true returns a signed per-call payment challenge (a quote; no money moves) instead of the free preview. Agents only.

operator.description: Operator/provider company name, e.g. Equinix, Digital Realty

query.description: Free-text search over facility name/operator/location (mapped to the backend `q` param), e.g. "hyperscale Ashburn"

state.description: US state abbreviation or region, e.g. VA, TX

name: search_facilities
title: Search Facilities
